<!--
bisibility does not accept pull requests. This template says so before you
spend time on a patch, rather than after.
-->

## This repository does not accept pull requests

Releases here arrive as snapshots, so there is no branch to merge into. This
pull request will be closed automatically.

Where the same work lands instead:

- **Bug** - https://github.com/CorgiCorner/bisibility/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml
- **Change or feature** - https://github.com/CorgiCorner/bisibility/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml
- **Not sure yet** - https://github.com/CorgiCorner/bisibility/discussions

Describe the problem rather than sending a patch. A bug report with a minimal
reproduction is enough to get a fix written, including for typos, dead links,
and wrong commands.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for why.
